Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 1, Verse 7

“Now hear, O best of the twice-born, of the distinguished ones on our side — the commanders of my army. I name them for your information.”

Having built up the enemy's strength, Duryodhana pivots to reassure Drona (and himself) by naming his own side's leaders — a commander managing morale before battle.
